t: Multi-purpose screw with Net-Coat treatment to protect against corrosion. A twin and single thread in one. The twin offers an easy start whilst the single thread grips firmly in the timber. Suitable for use with outdoor ironmongery, outdoor furniture, pressure-treated timber and fencing.
